mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals deepening labor market distress, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) below -0.5% and unemployment rise (UNRATE) above 0.3% indicates severe labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth falls below -0.5% and UNRATE rises above 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a federal funds rate increase above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 1.0% month-over-month for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a decline in real consumer credit (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% month-over-month signals reduced household spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by more than 0.5% MoM during post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumer credit (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% month-over-month indicates broad-based demand weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% and RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% MoM.
